A func_plat (1) is the lift, and a game_end (13) closes the mod. The measurement reports no unreached items and no walk warnings.

P8.reason: The measurements report no check errors, no notReached items and no reach warnings, so the map compiles and the walk test reaches its items. The game_end closes the mod in place of a changelevel, as the brief asks.

P9.reason: From inside, the room reads as a plain box with a sandy wall, a grey ceiling and water on the floor. Nothing in the views says control room over a pump hall: no window onto a hall, no console, no valve wheel. A player would not recognise the brief's place from these views.
